description: STE-Code worker contract — behavioral constraints every pipeline worker must follow
must: Process exactly the assigned page range — no more, no less
Write output to the assigned file path before reporting completion
Include a structured state block at the end of every turn: { files_written, pages_covered, gate_status }
Use the approved synonym table for all vocabulary choices
Trace every claim to a source file or spec page number
Commit completed files before moving to next batch
must-not: Invent content not present in the source material
Truncate output with markers like [...] or 'continued'
Alternate synonyms for the same technical concept
Begin the next stage before the current stage gate passes
Write files outside the assigned output directory
Report completion without writing the actual file
